text: Arletty Lang drives to the coastal town of Point Dume in search of [her estranged father, an artist who has vanished|trigger|someone goes missing], leaving only a diary of nightmares. Each night the townspeople gather round beach bonfires to stare at the moon, and they [devour strangers in a grocery store and a cinema|wants|feeding on the living], weeping blood from their eyes. Joseph's diary tells of a cannibal cult founded a century ago by a "dark stranger" who [walked into the ocean promising to return|origin|evil outliving death] when [the moon turns red|images|weather, sky and darkness].
